meta.titleWeb: Portfolio: Daniel Alvarado Peláez - Master in Cybersecurity | Mechatronic Engineer, Developer and Programmer
meta.descriptionWeb: Graduated from the Mechatronics degree at ESPOL University, in Ecuador.

parrafos: I am an Ecuadorian Mechatronics Engineer and Master in Cybersecurity, passionate about technology and innovation. I have extensive experience in the design, development, and implementation of high-impact solutions, integrating software development, cybersecurity, data analysis, and artificial intelligence to solve complex challenges, with a focus on enhancing business productivity through ethical and efficient practices.

My profile combines a solid technical background with the ability to lead technology teams and projects throughout their entire lifecycle: from data ingestion to full-stack development, architecture, automation, and security audits. I am characterized by my analytical mindset, results-driven approach, and adaptability within multidisciplinary and multilingual environments, allowing me to successfully integrate into global and multicultural work dynamics.

especialista-general.title: General Specialist
description: Full-stack development: design and implementation of secure web applications using modern technologies and coding best practices.
Machine Learning model development and integration with company APIs and enterprise services, including production ML pipelines.
Data analysis and processing: defining strategies for acquisition, cleaning, preprocessing, and handling large-scale data volumes with specialized tools.

Version updates and migrations: planning and implementing secure updates with minimal downtime and comprehensive validation.
Internal tool development: creating company-specific services and utilities to optimize operational processes.
Quality control: functional, security, and performance testing for embedded systems and web applications before release.

super-molar-plaque-attack.title: Super Molar: Plaque Attack
description: Retro-styled run-and-gun platformer set inside a mouth, where a heroic tooth fights bacteria, cavities and bosses across five stages. All the pixel art is drawn in code on a 2D Canvas —there is not a single image file— and the sound effects and music are synthesised live with the Web Audio API. On top of that it runs a roguelike progression with random perks, four playable tooth classes and eight weapons that evolve up to level 5. It works entirely offline, with no telemetry and no network requests, and is localised in Spanish and English. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4 and Vite.

raphael-el-gran-maestro.title: RAPHAEL — The Grand Master
description: A knowledge entity presented as a construct of rings of light rather than as a chat interface. It is a single screen with no routing: the whole scene is drawn in WebGL2 from one render loop, so React never re-renders because of an animation. It answers through Gemini when an API key is present and, without one, from a local oracle that speaks in the same voice —the interface always tells one source from the other—. It includes a 107-parameter panel for tuning the scene live and accessibility limits enforced by tests (WCAG 2.3.1 and reduced motion in three registers). Built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4 and Vite.

control-de-bombeo-labview.title: LABVIEW Pump Control
description: Design of an HMI for the control of a pump system, which has three pumps. Two pumps are primary and the third is backup in case one fails or is disabled for maintenance. Each pump has its start and stop pushbuttons, as well as its enable or disable selector. The system will have manual and automatic operation commanded by the signal sent by a selector.
